subject.title: [Bug]: reasoning_content leaks into chat output with moonshot/kimi-k2.6, frontend reasoning status out of sync

question: Should native Moonshot adopt the bounded Kimi inline-reasoning sanitizer after a native K2.6 stream capture confirms the same stable delimiter?
rationale: This intentionally rewrites ordinary provider content, trading potential answer suppression and streaming delay against preventing unintended reasoning disclosure; repository policy requires explicit owner acceptance for that boundary and any shared plugin API surface.

options.title: Confirm and reuse sanitizer
options.body: Capture native Moonshot wire output, factor the established bounded Kimi algorithm into an approved shared seam, and scope it to confirmed affected models.

options.title: Keep content authoritative
options.body: Do not rewrite ordinary Moonshot content and document that K2.6 may narrate reasoning despite disabled controls.

options.title: Wait for upstream behavior
options.body: Pause implementation until Moonshot reliably honors disabled thinking or exposes a structured reasoning boundary.

recommendation.title: Confirm and reuse sanitizer
recommendation.body: Capture native Moonshot wire output, factor the established bounded Kimi algorithm into an approved shared seam, and scope it to confirmed affected models.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the canonical generic boundary and already evaluated the same disclosure-versus-answer-integrity tradeoff for the merged sibling sanitizer.
